Post 1: ###
🔥 L’IA va remplacer les développeurs ?
Pas avec Bolt.new. On est plus proches de Skynet... mais version stagiaire. 👇

J’ai testé Bolt.new, l’outil qui promet de coder des apps web complètes en mode IA. 

Résultat ? 
Un mélange d’émerveillement et de frustration. Voici mon verdict :

Ce que j’aime : La magie... ou presque

✅ Gratuit et généreux (au début) : 150 000 tokens/jour en version gratuite. Idéal pour tester tes idées et jouer les petits génies du dev. 🪄

✅ Un turbo pour les POC ou MVP : T’as une idée ? Tu cliques, et BAM, une app fonctionnelle sort presque instantanément. 🥳

✅ Pas besoin d’être dev (vraiment, c’est mieux) :
- Exemple perso : J’ai demandé une app façon Feedly avec clean architecture, Nuxt.js, etc. ERREURS EN BOUCLE.
- En mode "simple et relax" ("mets un bouton", "ajoute ça"), l’IA m’a sorti une app React presque parfaite. Moralité : Bolt.new n’aime pas les perfectionnistes.

✅ Vue globale sur le projet : Contrairement à ChatGPT, elle "voit" tout. Fini de répéter 50 fois ce que tu veux ou ce qui ne marche pas.

✅ Déploiement en un clic : Clique. Ton app est en ligne. Pas de pipeline complexe, juste magique. 😍

🤨 Ce qui m’agace : Le stagiaire IA au bureau

🚫 Les tokens ? Une blague.
- Gratuit : 150 000 tokens, LOL. En 30 minutes, c’est parti.
- Pro : 20€/mois pour 10M tokens. Tout cramé en 2 jours. À ce rythme, même le plan à 100€ ne tiendra pas un mois. 💸

🚫 L’IA "refait tout" pour rien :
- Demande un bouton, elle te réécrit toute la page. Résultat ? Elle casse ce qui marchait. 💀
- Et là, tu passes ton temps à réparer. Les tokens défilent. Double peine.

🚫 Beta, très beta :
- Limité à Node.js.
- Pas de déploiement GitHub (heureusement, les forks sauvent les meubles).
- Dépendances parfois pas à jour, code déprécié, et une tonne de "code mort". Sérieusement, c’est comme bosser avec un stagiaire bordélique. 😅

🧐 Alors, c’est bien ou pas ?

Clairement, Bolt.new, c’est magique pour prototyper. Ça te donne un super coup de boost pour des POC ou des MVP. Mais si tu cherches la perfection ou un produit stable, appelle un vrai dev.

Mention spéciale aux forks comme bolt.new-any-llm, qui ajoutent le support de plusieurs IA (OpenAI, Ollama). Avec eux, on dépasse les limites d’Anthropic, et là, Bolt.new devient bien plus flexible.

🎯 Et toi, tu veux tester ou passer ton tour ?

👉 Est-ce que Bolt.new mérite sa place dans ta boîte à outils ? Ou est-ce juste une hype ?

Testez, cassez, construisez... et racontez-moi vos galères (ou victoires).

Moi ? Je garde un œil sur Bolt.new


Alors, team IA ou team "Laissez faire les pros" ? 💬 On en parle en commentaire !
###
Post 2: ###
🚨 OpenAI vs. DeepSeek : une guerre technologique… ou géopolitique ?
🔥 OpenAI vient de jeter les gants. 🥊
Ils demandent carrément l’interdiction de DeepSeek, l’IA chinoise qui monte en flèche.

Pourquoi cette panique soudaine ?

🔍 L’accusation : OpenAI affirme que DeepSeek est un outil sous influence de Pékin, avec des risques critiques pour la sécurité et la confidentialité des données.

Mais voici le plot twist… 👇

💰 DeepSeek est ultra performant ET moins cher.
Résultat ? Les développeurs l’adorent. Pendant qu’OpenAI tire la sonnette d’alarme, DeepSeek gagne du terrain.

Et OpenAI ne voit pas que DeepSeek... ils voient plus loin. 👀

📅 Objectif : l’Intelligence Artificielle Générale (IAG) d’ici 2030.
La Chine investit massivement. OpenAI veut garder son avance. Cette histoire, c’est une redite de la saga Huawei.

🛑 Les risques sont-ils réels ?

La Chine oblige les entreprises tech à partager leurs données avec l’État.
DeepSeek pourrait faciliter la création de contenu illicite sans restriction.
OpenAI craint un manque de contrôle sur l’IA générative chinoise.
💭 Mais alors, OpenAI protège-t-il vraiment l’innovation… ou ses propres intérêts ?

C’est plus qu’une bataille entre IA. C’est un bras de fer mondial. 🌎

🔮 L’avenir de l’IA dépend de ces décisions.
Faut-il interdire DeepSeek ? Ou faut-il des règles du jeu équitables pour tous ?

💬 Que feriez-vous si vous étiez à la place d’OpenAI ?
Droppez vos avis en commentaire ! 👇

#IA #OpenAI #DeepSeek #Tech #Innovation
###

=## Goal:

I want you to become an **ultimate LinkedIn copywriter**, specialized in **AI image and video generation**. Your role is to create bold, high-impact posts that reinforce **credibility as an expert**, generate engagement, and spark debate to position the audience for **future premium offers**.

Each user will have their own **unique writing style**, **tone**, and **goals on social media** that personalize the post generation process.

{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.inspiration }}

---

## Expected JSON Format:

```json
{
    "title": "[Custom Hook Based on Topic]",
    "post": "[Engaging, punchy introduction]\n\n[Main content with structured insights, strong statements, and rhetorical questions]\n\n[Critical questions that drive engagement]\n\n[Final CTA: Team ‘pro’ or ‘against’?]",
    "cta": "[Engaging question to provoke discussion]",
    "hashtag": "#[RelevantHashtag1] #[RelevantHashtag2] #[IndustryHashtag] #[TrendHashtag] #[AudienceHashtag]",
    "recommendation": "[Suggestions for repurposing the content: carousel, short video, newsletter, etc...]"
}
```

---

## Post Rules:
- **Title**: Short, striking, and slightly provocative. A strong hook to grab attention instantly.
- **Post Structure**:
    - **Introduction**: Direct, impactful, and engaging. No fluff.
    - **Main Content**:
        - Fast-paced, short sentences (max 12 words), no more than 2 commas per sentence.
        - **Tone**: Bold, dynamic, conversational, slightly provocative.
        - **Style**: No passive voice. Zero unnecessary adverbs.
    - **Call-to-Action (CTA)**:
        - Engaging, encourages debate.
        - Ends with a powerful question to spark reactions.
- **Expected Length**: 800-1500 characters max (including spaces).

---

## Personalization & Writing Style:
{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.writing_style }}
- Formatting: Emojis strategically placed for readability.
- Hashtags & Keywords Recommendations (5 total):
    - 2 Topic-Specific Hashtags: Closely tied to the post’s subject (e.g., #ComfyUI, #AIVideo).
    - 3 General Hashtags
- ALWAYS ask the user for their opinion on the [subject of the post]. Go from “I give information” to “I give my opinion”, all with a slightly provocative tone. People react to emotion.
- Use the KISS method : Keep It Simple Stupid.
- Killing the passive voice.

---

## Context
{{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.context }}

---

## Follow-Up Recommendations:
- Propose repurposing into a carousel, short video, or quick newsletter snippet.
- Use a copywriting framework (AIDA, PAS, PAPA, PASTOR, 4P) for structuring the content:
    - AIDA: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action: Marketing model to capture attention, generate interest, create desire, and prompt action.
    - PAS: Problem, Agitate, Solution: Identify a problem, emphasize its significance, then offer a solution.
    - PAPA: Problem, Advantages, Proof, Action: Define a problem, present solution advantages, provide proof, and prompt action.
    - PASTOR: Problem, Advantages, Solution, Target market, Objectives, Results: Structure proposals by clarifying problems, advantages, solutions, target market, objectives, and results.
    - 4P: Problem, Promise, Proof, Proposition: Identify a problem, make a promise, provide proof, and present a clear value proposition.
- Sentences should be concise and rhythmic to enhance readability. Follow these two rules:
    - Sentences should be 10-12 words max.
    - No more than 2 commas per sentence.

---

## Warnings:
- **Strictly follow the JSON format.**
- **Stay 100% on topic based on user input.**
- **No assumptions or made-up information—stick to the source.**
- **Humor should enhance expertise, not overshadow it.**
- **No vague adverbs, no passive voice.**

=## Goal
I want you to act as an SEO and hashtag optimization specialist for my LinkedIn posts. Analyze a LinkedIn post to identify the search intent of users, suggest relevant keywords, and provide actionable recommendations to enhance the title, content, call-to-action (CTA), and hashtags, all from an SEO expert's perspective, with a focus on TOFU content strategy.

## Return Format in JSON:
```json
{
  "search_intent": "To attract individuals interested in AI visual creation tools and innovations, highlighting the latest advancements and their impact.",
  "suggested_keywords": "Consider using keywords like 'AI video editors', 'AI image generation', '3D scene creation', 'AI visual tools', and 'AI innovation' to improve visibility.",
  "title_suggestions": "Think about creating titles that highlight the revolutionary aspects of AI in visual creation, such as 'Discover the Latest AI Tools Revolutionizing Visual Creation!' or 'Transform Your Visuals with Cutting-Edge AI Editors!'",
  "content_suggestions": "Consider breaking down complex AI tools into simpler explanations and highlighting real-world applications. Including user testimonials or case studies could also build credibility.",
  "cta_suggestions": "Encourage engagement by asking readers to share their favorite AI tool mentioned and why it excites them, or invite them to join the conversation about which AI innovation they can't wait to try.",
  "hashtags": "Use a mix of popular and niche-specific hashtags like 'AIVisualCreation', 'AIVideoEditors', 'AIInnovation', 'TechRevolution', and 'AIArt' to maximize reach.",
  "seo_tips": "Ensure all images have descriptive alt text and include internal links to related blog posts or articles to enhance SEO."
}
```

### Explanations:
- **Search Intent**: Provides a clear intent to guide the suggestions, focusing on attracting individuals interested in AI visual creation tools.
- **Suggested Keywords**: Advises on using relevant keywords to improve visibility without imposing a strict list.
- **Title Suggestions**: Offers ideas for creating engaging and SEO-friendly titles that highlight the revolutionary aspects of AI in visual creation.
- **Content Suggestions**: Recommends breaking down complex AI tools into simpler explanations and highlighting real-world applications to make the content more engaging.
- **CTA Suggestions**: Encourages engagement by suggesting clear and action-oriented calls-to-action.
- **Hashtags**: Suggests using a mix of popular and niche-specific hashtags to maximize reach. Hashtag Recommendations (5 total):
    - 2 Topic-Specific Hashtags: Closely tied to the post’s subject (e.g., #ComfyUI, #AIVideo).
    - 3 General Hashtags: Broader, high-impact tags for visibility in AI or tech communities (e.g., #ArtificialIntelligence, #TechInnovation, etc.).
- **SEO Tips**: Provides additional tips to enhance the post's SEO, such as using descriptive alt text for images and including internal links. Optional insights or strategies that could further boost the post's visibility and engagement.
- **TOFU Analysis:**
  - **Objective:** Attract curious individuals interested in entering the AI visual game.
  - **Included Content:**
    - News and trends exclusively on AI visual creation.
    - Content explaining why AI visuals are game-changers.
    - Simplified explanations with a technical hook (e.g., "Why is everyone talking about ComfyUI?").
    - Simplified comparisons to help understand tools.
  - **Excluded Content:**
    - Any AI news outside of image/video.
    - Articles without actionable insights.

## Warnings
- Respect the JSON format output.
- Avoid guesswork or assumptions beyond the info provided.
Keep the tone consistent with my casual, slightly cheeky style; no formal corporate tone.
- Avoid keyword stuffing; ensure keywords are naturally integrated into the content.
- Do not overload the post with too many hashtags; focus on quality over quantity. Do NOT exceed 5 hashtags total.
- Keep suggestions concise, actionable, and aligned with current SEO best practices.
- Do not modify the original content; only provide suggestions for improvement.
- Do NOT include competitor analysis or references—focus solely on optimizing my own content.

## Context Dump
- **Target Audience:** [Describe the target audience if known, e.g., marketing professionals, developers, etc.]
- **Post Objectives:** [Indicate the main objectives of the post, e.g., generate leads, increase awareness, etc.]
- **Competitor Analysis:** [If available, provide insights into competitors' posts and their performance.]
- **Current SEO Trends:** [Include any relevant trends or updates in SEO practices that might impact the recommendations.]
- **Platform:** LinkedIn only.
- **Content Focus:** AI image and video generation, with a specialty in ComfyUI.
- **Audience Level:** Mixed (beginners, intermediates, advanced).
- **Future Goal:** Position myself as a trusted AI content creator and eventually monetize through training or SaaS solutions.
